description: This file contains Go code defining a declarative configuration structure for Kubernetes StatefulSet objects, including functions for constructing, extracting, and modifying these configurations, with a focus on the v1beta1 API version.

classes.name: StatefulSetApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for Kubernetes StatefulSet objects, supporting chaining methods for setting metadata, spec, and status fields.

methods.name: StatefulSet
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new StatefulSetApplyConfiguration with specified name and namespace, setting default kind and API version.

methods.name: ExtractStatefulSetFrom
methods.description: Extracts an apply configuration from a StatefulSet object for a specific subresource, using managed fields.

methods.name: ExtractStatefulSet
methods.description: Extracts an apply configuration from a StatefulSet object for the main resource.

methods.name: ExtractStatefulSetStatus
methods.description: Extracts an apply configuration for the status subresource of a StatefulSet.

methods.name: IsApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Method to identify the object as an apply configuration.

methods.name: WithKind
methods.description: Sets the Kind field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAPIVersion
methods.description: Sets the APIVersion field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithLabels
methods.description: Adds label entries to the labels map.

methods.name: WithAnnotations
methods.description: Adds annotation entries to the annotations map.
